blocks.text: Hollywood actress-producer and philantropist Angelina Jolie hopes to lead a simpler, more peaceful life while continuing to serve others as she looks toward the next decade. Jolie was asked about her vision for the region and what she hopes success would look like 10 years from now during the 2026 ASEAN Inclusive Growth Summit on Wednesday, Nov. 11, in Manila. The 51-year-old actress said her aspirations have become more personal over time, particularly when she became a parent. “When you’re a parent, you just want to be here, and you just want to be more healthy, and you feel like if […]...
